Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve

Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
Identify and communicate system and process issues to L&D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes.O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.Perfil desejado:
Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;
Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Descrição
O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Associate ii, pharmacovigilance - brazil - remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at WorldwideResponsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.What you will doAuthor Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as neededWhat you will bring to the roleStrong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilitiesYour experienceMinimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, Power Point, Word)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Descrição
O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes.O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.Perfil desejado:
Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;
Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Descrição
O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English

Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment. Vision & Mission:
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior frontend engineer
description:
Note: This role is 100% remote, but we require overlap with Eastern Time (EST/EDT) working hours to ensure smooth collaboration with the team.
Company Introduction
Next Day AI is a privately held company specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2 C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. With over 35 millions+ messages per day and millions of monthly visitors, our products are revolutionizing the way people interact with AI.
This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers.
Job Description
We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who can own and drive the frontend experience across our web and mobile products. We need someone who sees problems, proposes solutions, and ships them. You'll be working across a modern React (web) and React Native (mobile) codebase, building features used by millions of users every day.
You'll care deeply about code quality, maintainability, and performance - and you'll champion the use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to move faster without sacrificing standards. You're the kind of engineer who treats AI coding assistants as a force multiplier, not a crutch, and you're always looking for ways to improve code quality and performance with these tools.
This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineers, and QA - but at the end of the day, you'll own your domain and be trusted to make the right calls.
What You'll Do
Build, ship, and maintain high-quality features across our React web application and React Native mobile app, working across the full frontend surface area.
Take ownership of major frontend initiatives end-to-end - from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment - without needing hand-holding.
Write clean, well-tested, maintainable Type Script code that other engineers can confidently build on. Champion code quality standards, review PRs thoroughly, and help to raise the bar for the whole team.
Actively leverage AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Git Hub Copilot, or similar) and agentic workflows to accelerate development. Advocate for and help the team adopt best practices around AI-augmented engineering.
Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into elegant, performant user experiences. Push back when something doesn't make sense and propose better alternatives.
Improve our frontend architecture, patterns, and tooling. Identify technical debt and address it proactively - you don't wait for permission to make things better.
Contribute to our shared business logic and component libraries, ensuring consistency across web and mobile platforms.
Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing. Lead by example. What We're Looking For
5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong track record of shipping production software at scale.
Deep expertise in React and the modern React ecosystem (hooks, context, routing, state management). You don't just use React - you understand it.
Solid experience with React Native or strong willingness to ramp up quickly. We need someone comfortable building across both web and mobile.
Advanced Type Script proficiency. You write typed code by default and understand how to use the type system to prevent bugs and improve developer experience.
A genuine passion for clean, maintainable code. You care about naming things well, keeping components focused, writing meaningful tests, and leaving code better than you found it.
Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted development tools and a clear point of view on how to use them effectively. You're a champion of agentic coding workflows and can show how you've used them to ship faster.
Self-directed and proactive. You take initiative, own your work fully, and don't need to be managed closely. You see what needs doing and do it.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You can articulate technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm. Nice to have
Familiarity with our tech stack:
React 18, React Native, Type Script, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Vitest, React Testing Library, Git Hub Actions, Yarn 4
Experience with real-time features (Socket. Io, Web Sockets) and streaming interfaces
Experience building and consuming shared component libraries or design systems
Familiarity with feature flag systems (Growth Book or similar) and progressive rollout strategies
Background in B2 C consumer products with high traffic and millions of daily active users
Experience with PWA architecture, service workers, and offline-first patterns
Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence)
Interest or experience in AI/LLM products and conversational interfaces Why join us?
Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to "once per week")
Flex-time / Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results, not hours)
Unlimited Vacations Policy
Competitive salary and benefits package.
A dynamic and supportive work environment. If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team on the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

Sobre nós:
A ITC Infotech é uma empresa líder global em serviços e soluções de tecnologia, com forte atuação em Consultoria de Negócios e Tecnologia. A ITC Infotech oferece soluções práticas para ajudar seus clientes a terem sucesso e estarem preparados para o futuro, combinando perfeitamente expertise digital, fortes alianças específicas em cada setor e a capacidade única de aproveitar o profundo conhecimento de domínio das empresas do Grupo ITC. Fornecemos soluções e serviços de tecnologia para empresas em diversos setores, como Bancos e Serviços Financeiros, Saúde, Manufatura, Bens de Consumo, Viagens e Hotelaria, por meio da combinação de modelos de negócios tradicionais e inovadores, atuando como um parceiro sustentável de longo prazo.
Resumo da vaga:
Estamos procurando por um Engenheiro de Suporte Nível 3 com forte experiência prática, que atuará como ponto focal de escalonamento para problemas críticos em ambientes de produção para sistemas de negociação e risco. A função tem foco no diagnóstico profundo de incidentes, na parceria com a engenharia para correções e melhorias no nível de confiabilidade, na criação de ferramentas, manuais de procedimentos e documentação que permitam que as equipes de Nível 1/2 resolvam os problemas de forma mais rápida e eficiente.
Responsabilidades:
Gerenciar de ponta a ponta os escalonamentos de nível 3: incluindo triagem, análise da causa raiz, correção e o acompanhamento pós-incidente junto com a equipe de engenharia e as demais partes interessadas.
Colaborar com as equipes de produto e engenharia para aprimorar a confiabilidade, a operabilidade e a capacidade de suporte das aplicações, incluindo registro de logs, métricas e qualidade dos alertas.
Desenvolver scripts, manuais de operação, diagnósticos e ferramentas de qualidade que agilizem as investigações e reduzam o tempo médio de resolução.
Criar e manter documentação clara para as equipes de nível 1 e 2; ministrar treinamentos conforme necessário.
Contribuir para as revisões de incidentes e gerenciamento de problemas, promovendo correções permanentes e automação para problemas recorrentes.
Participar de um rodízio limitado de fins de semana/plantão (aproximadamente 4 a 6 por ano) com folgas compensatórias conforme a política da empresa. Qualificações mínimas:
Graduação de nível Superior (ou experiência equivalente), e mais de 3 anos de experiência em engenharia de software ou suporte à sistemas em produção.
Proficiência em Java ou linguagem similar; fortes habilidades de depuração e capacidade de escrever scripts para diagnósticos e atualizações. Familiaridade com Linux e bash.
Excelente comunicação, clara e empática, com habilidades para traduzir problemas técnicos complexos para públicos técnico e não técnico.
Postura proativa, atuando na resolução de incidentes ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve soluções e automações de longo prazo.
Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas, incluindo identificação de casos extremos, implementação de validações e antecipação de possíveis modelos de falha.
Experiência com o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) e ferramentas de suporte, como Git Lab, sistemas de gerenciamento de incidentes, JIRA e processos padrão de triagem e priorização de tickets. Qualificações desejáveis:
Experiência em suporte a sistemas ou mesas de negociação em grandes bancos de investimento ou instituições financeiras de porte semelhante.
Proficiência em SQL para validação rápida de dados e triagem eficiente de incidentes.
Experiência com programação orientada a objetos e arquitetura Java/SOA baseados em microsserviços.
Experiência na configuração e otimização de monitoramento de alertas, utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Pager Duty.
Conhecimento de produtos de Renda Fixa (Taxas, Crédito, Câmbio, Commodities) e dos respectivos fluxos de trabalho de mercado.
Familiaridade com práticas de Dev Ops/CI/CD e metodologia ágil. Modelo de trabalho e cronograma
Forte Colaboração com as equipes de engenharia e de suporte as operações de negociação.
Rodízio de plantão em fins de semana, estimado em aproximadamente 4 a 6 fins de semana por ano, com o cronograma definido e comunicado com antecedência. A ITC Infotech é uma empregadora que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Acreditamos que ninguém deve ser discriminado por suas diferenças, como idade, deficiência, etnia, gênero, identidade e expressão de gênero, religião ou orientação sexual. Todas as decisões de emprego serão tomadas sem levar em consideração idade, raça, credo, cor, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, ascendência, deficiência, condição de veterano, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, informações genéticas, estado civil, cidadania ou qualquer outra condição protegida por leis federais, estaduais ou locais. title: Senior frontend engineer
description:
Note: This role is 100% remote, but we require overlap with Eastern Time (EST/EDT) working hours to ensure smooth collaboration with the team.
Company Introduction
Next Day AI is a privately held company specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2 C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. With over 35 millions+ messages per day and millions of monthly visitors, our products are revolutionizing the way people interact with AI.
This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers.
Job Description
We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who can own and drive the frontend experience across our web and mobile products. We need someone who sees problems, proposes solutions, and ships them. You'll be working across a modern React (web) and React Native (mobile) codebase, building features used by millions of users every day.
You'll care deeply about code quality, maintainability, and performance - and you'll champion the use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to move faster without sacrificing standards. You're the kind of engineer who treats AI coding assistants as a force multiplier, not a crutch, and you're always looking for ways to improve code quality and performance with these tools.
This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineers, and QA - but at the end of the day, you'll own your domain and be trusted to make the right calls.
What You'll Do
Build, ship, and maintain high-quality features across our React web application and React Native mobile app, working across the full frontend surface area.
Take ownership of major frontend initiatives end-to-end - from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment - without needing hand-holding.
Write clean, well-tested, maintainable Type Script code that other engineers can confidently build on. Champion code quality standards, review PRs thoroughly, and help to raise the bar for the whole team.
Actively leverage AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Git Hub Copilot, or similar) and agentic workflows to accelerate development. Advocate for and help the team adopt best practices around AI-augmented engineering.
Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into elegant, performant user experiences. Push back when something doesn't make sense and propose better alternatives.
Improve our frontend architecture, patterns, and tooling. Identify technical debt and address it proactively - you don't wait for permission to make things better.
Contribute to our shared business logic and component libraries, ensuring consistency across web and mobile platforms.
Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing. Lead by example. What We're Looking For
5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong track record of shipping production software at scale.
Deep expertise in React and the modern React ecosystem (hooks, context, routing, state management). You don't just use React - you understand it.
Solid experience with React Native or strong willingness to ramp up quickly. We need someone comfortable building across both web and mobile.
Advanced Type Script proficiency. You write typed code by default and understand how to use the type system to prevent bugs and improve developer experience.
A genuine passion for clean, maintainable code. You care about naming things well, keeping components focused, writing meaningful tests, and leaving code better than you found it.
Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted development tools and a clear point of view on how to use them effectively. You're a champion of agentic coding workflows and can show how you've used them to ship faster.
Self-directed and proactive. You take initiative, own your work fully, and don't need to be managed closely. You see what needs doing and do it.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You can articulate technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm. Nice to have
Familiarity with our tech stack:
React 18, React Native, Type Script, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Vitest, React Testing Library, Git Hub Actions, Yarn 4
Experience with real-time features (Socket.io, Web Sockets) and streaming interfaces
Experience building and consuming shared component libraries or design systems
Familiarity with feature flag systems (Growth Book or similar) and progressive rollout strategies
Background in B2 C consumer products with high traffic and millions of daily active users
Experience with PWA architecture, service workers, and offline-first patterns
Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence)
Interest or experience in AI/LLM products and conversational interfaces Why join us?
Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to "once per week")
Flex-time / Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results, not hours)
Unlimited Vacations Policy
Competitive salary and benefits package.
A dynamic and supportive work environment. If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team on the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

Required Qualifications
- 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role within data services, AI/ML, or robotics.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Strong understanding of autonomous driving and/or robotics data pipelines: sensor fusion, data collection at scale, annotation workflows, and quality assurance.
- Familiarity with machine learning model-training workflows, including data curation, labeling taxonomies, and evaluation metrics.
- Experience with at least two of: Li DAR point-cloud processing, camera/image annotation, 3 D reconstruction, or simulation environments.
- Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear proposals and commercial terms.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to both engineers and business teams.
Preferred Qualifications
- Direct experience with ADAS or L2–L5 autonomous driving programs at an OEM, Tier-1, or technology partner.
- Hands-on exposure to VLMs, VLAs, or sim-to-real transfer techniques.
- Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or equivalent robotics simulation platforms.
- Experience scoping egocentric data collection projects (AR/VR headsets, wearable sensors).
- Prior work at a Robotics, ADAS or AI training-data company.
- Master's degree or higher in a relevant technical discipline.
What We Offer
- A front-row seat to the Physical AI revolution, working with leading robotics and autonomous vehicle companies worldwide.
- Competitive base salary.
- Comprehensive benefits package.
- Flexible remote-first culture.

title: Coordenador(a) de sucesso do cliente
description:
Somos o futuro da Gestão de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho!
SOBRE NÓ S
A Vixting está revolucionando a Admissão Digital e a Gestão Ocupacional no Brasil!
Com tecnologia de ponta, oferecemos soluções práticas e inteligentes que simplificam a rotina dos nossos clientes. Aqui, nosso foco vai além de serviços; acreditamos nas pessoas e na força de conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão pelo que fazemos.
Acreditamos que cada pessoa tem um valor único e que o alinhamento cultural é o alicerce para relações duradouras e impactantes. Aqui, construímos conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão por superar expectativas.
Criamos soluções estratégicas
Somos apaixonados pelo maior ativo de uma companhia: Pessoas! Prezamos a essência de cada ser humano, buscamos o fit cultural para ser a base da nossa relação. Construímos relacionamentos baseados em confiança, caráter, honestidade, ética e paixão por encantar!
Somos únicos.
Estamos em busca de um Coordenador(a) de Sucesso do cliente para se juntar ao nosso time!
Esse (a) profissional será responsável por garantir a melhor experiência e geração de valor para os clientes , acompanhando sua jornada, identificando oportunidades de evolução e atuando de forma estratégica na retenção e expansão da carteira.
COOORDENADOR(A) DE SUCESSO DO CLIENTE
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Coordenar as atividades da área de Customer Success, organizando a rotina e garantindo a eficiência do time;
Gerir a jornada do cliente de ponta a ponta, desde o onboarding até a renovação e expansão;
Estruturar, acompanhar e monitorar indicadores de sucesso do cliente (health score, churn, NPS e engajamento);
Criar e manter rituais de acompanhamento da base de clientes (reuniões periódicas, QBRs e análises de carteira);
Identificar riscos de churn e definir planos de ação para retenção de clientes;
Atuar na expansão da base por meio de estratégias de upsell e cross-sell;
Organizar e padronizar processos, fluxos e playbooks da área de Customer Success;
Garantir a execução consistente do onboarding e a adoção dos produtos pelos clientes;
Atuar em parceria com áreas como Produto, Suporte, Comercial e Operações, alinhando a experiência do cliente;
Acompanhar feedbacks dos clientes e direcionar melhorias internas;
Apoiar a priorização de demandas com base no impacto na experiência do cliente;
Estruturar a segmentação da base de clientes e definir estratégias por perfil;
Monitorar e evoluir continuamente a experiência do cliente ao longo da jornada;
Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a capacitação do time de Customer Success;
Garantir o registro e a atualização das informações dos clientes em sistemas e ferramentas;
Gerar análises e relatórios gerenciais para apoiar a tomada de decisão;
Contribuir para a evolução estratégica da área de Customer Success, alinhada aos objetivos da empresa.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em gestão de Customer Success, Sucesso do Cliente, Relacionamento com Clientes ou áreas similares;
Vivência na gestão da jornada do cliente, com foco em retenção e expansão;
Experiência com indicadores e métricas de CS (health score, churn, NPS, CSAT e engajamento);
Capacidade de estruturar e organizar processos, rotinas e playbooks;
Experiência com coordenação de atividades ou liderança de times;
Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e plataformas de gestão de relacionamento;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de suporte e gestão de chamados;
Experiência com ferramentas de análise e dashboards;
Vivência em empresas Saa S ou modelos híbridos (software e serviços);
Experiência com onboarding e implantação de clientes;
Conhecimento em estratégias de upsell e cross-sell.
Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido, com atuação presencial 2 vezes por semana na região de Pinheiros – SP.
Horário de trabalho: de segunda á sexta das 09h00 ás 18h00
Nossos benefícios:
Vale refeição de R$ 38,00 por dia, sendo 22 dias úteis fixos;
Auxilio creche para mamãe ou papai;
Plano de saúde Alice sem mensalidade;
Plano odontológico Amil;
Wellhub;
Seguro de vida;
Day off.

title: Analista de impostos sr.
description:
A 360 Energy Brasil, empresa do grupo internacional 360 Energy, está em busca de um(a) Especialista / Analista de Impostos Sr.
A posição atuará como principal ponto focal para assuntos tributários no Brasil, trabalhando em estreita coordenação com a Gerência de Impostos do grupo na Argentina, à qual se reportará diretamente. O profissional será responsável por coordenar o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais da empresa em conjunto com o escritório externo.
Principais responsabilidades
Atuar como ponto focal para assuntos tributários da 360 Energy Brasil.
Coordenar o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais principais e acessórias, garantindo o atendimento adequado aos prazos e requisitos legais.
Atuar como principal interlocutor com o escritório externo, responsável pela preparação das declarações fiscais.
Coordenar o envio de informações e documentações para elaboração das declarações.
Acompanhar e revisar obrigações fiscais como ECD, ECF e demais declarações tributárias.
Acompanhar declarações e apurações relacionadas a PIS, COFINS, DIFAL e retenções (PIS, COFINS, CSLL, IRRF, INSS e ISS).
Realizar conciliações contábeis das contas de impostos.
Dar suporte técnico fiscal aos processos de compras, especialmente na orientação para emissão de pedidos.
Atender consultas fiscais das áreas internas, como Contas a Pagar, Tesouraria e demais áreas da empresa.
Manter atualizadas as informações fiscais do cadastro de fornecedores e tabelas fiscais no SAP.
Participar da implementação da reforma tributária no SAP, incluindo definições funcionais, reuniões com consultores e testes. Requisitos
Formação em Ciências Contábeis.
Sólidos conhecimentos em tributação brasileira.
Experiência em compliance fiscal e obrigações acessórias.
Experiência com ECD e ECF.
Conhecimento em SAP será considerado um diferencial ou forte interesse em aprender.
Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.
Perfil organizado, analítico e com capacidade de coordenação com consultores externos. Desejável
Experiência prévia em Big4 ou consultorias tributárias.
