title: Analista de segurança da informação
description:
Buscamos um profissional que será responsável por implementar processos e soluções de segurança da informação, visando promover a confidencialidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos dados e sistemas implantados e desenvolvidos para todas as unidades de negócio do Grupo Pereira.Se interessou e faz sentido para você e para a sua carreira? Veja as principais atividades:
• Apoiar na implementação de software de segurança da informação, através do acompanhamento de todo o processo assegurando o comprimento do cronograma.
• Monitorar e detectar ameaças em serviço de TI que comprometam a informação corporativa por meio de análise dos logs e de alertas de vulnerabilidade.
• Manter a política atualizada as estratégias da empresa através do apoio na definição de políticas de segurança da informação (PSI), junto a equipe de Segurança da Informação;
• Apoiar os usuários por meio de suporte técnico especializado no uso das funcionalidades de segurança da informação implantadas.
• Realizar testes de invasão por meio de ferramentas apropriadas garantindo a segurança do ambiente corporativo.
• Contribuir no desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) com foco na segurança por meio de atividades alinhadas com liderança;
• Atuar no desenvolvimento de automatização de testes de segurança, verificação de conformidade e análises estáticas de código através da contribuição na elaboração de mecanismos para este fim;
• Apoiar implementação e configuração de ferramentas de monitoramento de segurança para detecção de ameaças em tempo real por meio de práticas atuais do mercado e conhecimento da estrutura do grupo;
• Contribuir no controle de ambientes e configurações usando ferramentas de orquestração de contêineres como Docker e Kubernetes, garantindo a segurança dos contêineres.
• Identificar possíveis ameaças e recomendar soluções, por meio da realização de testes de segurança, varreduras e avaliações de vulnerabilidades.O que esperamos do(a) nosso(a) Analista de Segurança da Informação Júnior:
•Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Campo Grande/MS;
•Ensino Superior Completo em Ciência da Computação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
•Desejável 3 anos de experiência
•Desejável experiência com práticas Dev Ops. CI/DC e automação de processos;
•Desejável experiência em configuração e gestão de ambientes de contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Conhecimento em Sistemas Operacional Windows e Linux;
• Noções em ferramentas de segurança, como IDS/IPS, WAF, SIEM, etc;
• Noções de ambientes cloud AWS e GCP;
• Noções de linguagens de programação (Python, C#) e ferramentas de automação;
• Noções de diferentes protocolos e serviços de comunicação;
• Conhecimento em ferramentas de Firewall;
• Noções em práticas de segurança OWASP Top 10, Secure Coding, etc.O nosso propósito é ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, pensando nisso oferecemos:
• Plano de Saúde;
• Plano Odontológico;
• Seguro de Vida;
• Refeição no Local;
• Descontos especiais para compras em nossas redes;
• Suporte Social.Local de trabalho:Campo Grande, MS
Regime de contratação de tipo:Efetivo – CLT
Jornada:Período Integral
Área e especialização profissional:Informática, TI, Telecomunicações - Segurança da Informação
Nível hierárquico:Analista

title: Estagiário jurídico
description:
Descrição do CargoProcuramos um estagiário jurídico para apoiar nossa equipe em Porto Alegre, RS. As atividades diárias incluem o auxílio na elaboração de documentos jurídicos, especialmente voltados para documentos societários, tramites de atos perante órgãos públicos, acompanhamento de processos e apoio em consultorias jurídicas. Este é um cargo de meio período e exige presença no local.
Qualificações
Direito e Consultoria Jurídica:Conhecimento em legislação, interpretação de normas jurídicas e habilidades em prestar consultoria legal quando necessário.
Elaboração de Documentos Jurídicos:Experiência ou interesse em preparar contratos, petições, pareceres e outros documentos relacionados à área jurídica.
Comunicação e Resolução de Questões Jurídicas:Capacidade de comunicação clara e objetiva para interagir com clientes e resolver problemas legais de forma eficiente.
Conhecimento em informática básica e habilidades organizacionais serão considerados um diferencial, bem como estar cursando direito a partir do 4º semestre.
Desejável experiência em societário e tributário.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Fiscal com experiência sólida para integrar nosso time.
Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir com o crescimento dos nossos clientes, aplicando seu conhecimento técnico para garantir conformidade tributária, eficiência nos processos e soluções seguras.

Validar informações fiscais para garantir a correta execução de processos em outros departamentos;

Experiência mínima de 2 anos no setor fiscal;
Formação em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins (concluída ou em andamento);

Experiência em emissão de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos e obrigações acessórias;

title: Senior software engineer - game technology
description:
We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team in São Paulo.
At Wildlife, senior engineers don't just execute - they own. Our Live Games Tech Team operates with end-to-end accountability across some of our most-played titles, with millions of daily active players worldwide. You'll make architectural decisions, lead technical initiatives, define how the team operates in production, and mentor the engineers around you - all without layers of approval slowing you down. The scope is large. The autonomy is real. And the scale means your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on a product that millions of people play every day.
Our stack spans Unity/C# on the client, Go on the backend, and AWS with Kubernetes for infrastructure.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead the design and implementation of complex features across mobile client and backend services, making sound architectural trade-offs.
Own technical decisions for your area - architecture, performance, scalability, long-term maintainability - and be accountable for the outcomes.
Ship new versions to production and take full ownership of post-release behavior: monitoring, reading signals, and iterating fast.
Define and evolve the team's observability practices: SLIs, alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes.
Proactively identify and drive improvements across the codebase: performance, scalability, and engineering quality.
Mentor and coach more junior engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and pair programming.
Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages.
Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders. WHAT YOU'LL NEED
Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale.
Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments.
Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers.
Working proficiency in English. Nice to have
Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development.
Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems.
Experience with AWS infrastructure.
Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products. MORE ABOUT YOU
You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it.
ABOUT WILDLIFE
Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link ( Com/about/careers/)
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
- Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
- Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
- Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
- Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
- Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
- Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
- Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
- Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
- Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
- Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
- Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
- Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
- Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
- Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
- B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
- 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
- Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
- Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
- Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
- Based anywhere in Brazil
- Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
- Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
- Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
- Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
- Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
- Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
- Remote friendly work policies
- Professional development budget
- Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
- Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
- Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemblea diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor companyactivities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;
- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Senior qa analyst - live games
description:
We're looking for a talented and detail-obsessed Senior Quality Assurance Analyst to join Wildlife's Quality Assurance team, focused on our Live Games portfolio.
As a Senior QA Analyst, you will be responsible for estimating, planning, and executing test cases across our live titles — evaluating risks and impact, defining quality strategy, and helping the team grow through knowledge sharing. You will communicate testing demands and quality metrics to both developers and other analysts, owning the bridge between QA and engineering.
This role starts with broad coverage across all Wildlife live games, with the longer-term path of migrating into a single high-impact title as ownership deepens. Professional posture, sharp communication, and influence skills are essential - even though this is not a people-management role, you will interact across multiple disciplines and seniority levels.
The right person for this position is curious by nature, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and thrives in a fast-paced live operations context where every build matters.
What You'll Do
Execute manual testing with a meticulous eye across Wildlife's live games portfolio, ensuring every build meets our quality bar before reaching millions of daily players.
Own the end-to-end bug flow: identify, reproduce, write clear bug reports, prioritize based on impact, and decide whether issues go to backlog or require immediate fix.
Write, refine, and continuously optimize test cases - leveraging AI tools (Cursor, LLMs) to accelerate case creation and improve description quality at scale.
Apply AI-assisted build analysis: compare build A vs build B by analyzing code diffs (via Cursor), identifying changed files, and using structured prompts to surface high-risk areas before testing begins.
Hunt corner cases - go beyond the happy path to find edge scenarios that no one else catches, before players do.
Deploy builds on physical devices (i OS and Android), validating real-world behavior, performance, and UX.
Monitor and analyze post-release quality using Firebase, Crashlytics, and internal QA tooling (QA Hub).
Define and evolve quality metrics that engineering and product use to make decisions - not just report them.
Collaborate directly with engineering on debugging, prioritization, and release decisions.
Provide your team with a quality strategy that supports delivery goals and aligns with Wildlife's overall quality strategy.
Advocate for user experience and game quality across product, design, and engineering conversations.
Participate as one of the first analysts on new game projects when needed - helping new dev teams establish quality processes and standards from the ground up. What You'll Need
University degree in computing-related fields (Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Analysis and Development) - or equivalent practical experience.
Previous professional experience in software development or game testing, with at least 2 consecutive years in mobile games or high-cadence live operations environments.
Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals: data structures, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis.
Solid command of software testing concepts: testability, escape rate, regression, unit, integration, soak, stress, and test automation.
Demonstrated experience with Firebase, Crashlytics, or equivalent crash analytics and monitoring tooling in production environments.
Track record of writing, structuring, and optimizing test cases with method - not just executing scripts written by others.
Proven ability to identify non-obvious corner cases, with concrete examples of critical bugs you found that others missed.
Hands-on experience deploying and validating builds on physical i OS and Android devices.
Active use of AI in your QA workflow - Cursor, Chat GPT, Copilot, or equivalent tools applied to code analysis, test case generation, or debugging.
Clear technical communication - you can speak the developer's language without losing the quality lens. Nice to Have
Experience with live games at scale (millions of DAU).
Track record of creating quality metrics that were adopted by engineering teams.
Familiarity with Unity, C#, or mobile-native stacks.
Experience with mobile test automation (Appium, XCTest, Espresso) - even though this role is primarily manual.
Understanding of Dev Ops tools such as Chef, Ansible, Jenkins, or similar. More About You
You're passionate about games and about software development - and you know how to ensure its quality.
You thrive in agile environments and stimulate that mindset in your team.
You're creative when solving problems and continuously seek improvements in processes and solutions.
You communicate clearly with your team and the broader company to identify issues and align demands.
You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes on the final result.
You are professionally postured and exercise influence even outside of formal leadership roles - knowing how to interact with multiple disciplines and higher job levels with credibility. How We Work
This role is hybrid, with 3 days per week in our Itaim Bibi office (São Paulo). The in-person time is a deliberate accelerator for pair debugging, faster decisions with engineering, and high-bandwidth alignment. The remaining 2 days are remote.
About Wildlife
Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come.
Equal Opportunity

We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.
We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

Manutenção do Ambiente: Contribuir ativamente para a manutenção de um ambiente de trabalho organizado, funcional e produtivo. Habilidades e Competências que Buscamos:
Experiência Comprovada: Mínimo de 3 (três) anos de experiência sólida e comprovada como Secretário(a) Executivo(a) ou Assistente Administrativo(a) sênior, preferencialmente adquirida em escritórios de advocacia, consultorias ou ambientes corporativos de alta demanda, onde a confidencialidade e a precisão são cruciais.
Organização e Gestão do Tempo: Capacidade excepcional de planejar, priorizar e executar múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente, gerenciando prazos apertados com eficiência e mantendo um alto nível de organização em todas as atividades.
Comunicação Exímia: Excelente comunicação interpessoal, verbal e escrita, com clareza, concisão e profissionalismo, capaz de interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos, clientes de alto perfil e autoridades.
Proatividade e Iniciativa: Habilidade de antecipar necessidades, identificar problemas e propor soluções de forma autônoma, demonstrando iniciativa para otimizar processos e agregar valor ao dia a dia do escritório.
Discrição e Confidencialidade: Essencial para lidar com a natureza sensível das informações jurídicas e pessoais de nossos clientes, aderindo rigorosamente aos princípios da LGPD e ao código de ética profissional, mantendo a mais alta confidencialidade.
Domínio Tecnológico: Proficiência avançada no Pacote Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point, Teams), com habilidade para criar documentos, planilhas para relatórios e apresentações impactantes. Familiaridade com ferramentas de videoconferência (Zoom, Google Meet) e sistemas de gestão de processos jurídicos (CRM jurídico) ou plataformas de automação de escritório é um diferencial.
Orientação para Resultados: Foco em otimizar processos, identificar gargalos e contribuir ativamente para a eficiência geral do escritório, buscando sempre a melhoria contínua.
Resiliência e Flexibilidade: Capacidade de se adaptar rapidamente a novas demandas, lidar com situações imprevistas e manter a calma e a produtividade sob pressão.
Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor e precisão na execução de todas as tarefas, desde a revisão minuciosa de documentos até a organização de agendas, garantindo a ausência de erros e a conformidade com os padrões de qualidade. O Que Oferecemos:

We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
